note: There are no online trophies in GTA 6 — every trophy is single-player. No difficulty trophies, no mission medals, and one playthrough is enough. Around 200 hours to the platinum; difficulty about 4/10.

details: Turn on progress and collectible notifications in Settings.
Never use cheats on your trophy save — cheats disable trophies and saving.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission. There are 15 manual slots plus 1 autosave; there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
stages.title: Stage 0 — Before you start

details: Do Lucia’s balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth: follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept the optional task. It is gone after Chapter 1 and is the one possibly-missable step toward Positive Mental Attitude — whether the trophy strictly needs that spot is unconfirmed, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
Meet Cal in Feng Shui and start his fishing quests.
Finish an arcade game for Stick Fiddler.
Start Kenton’s treasure dives while he is around.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Chapter 1

details: Both characters are playable after Coffee Break — meditate together at every spot from here on, since meditating together counts twice.
Start Bret’s hunting, Billy’s Mudclub jobs, Randy’s Wish List (after the Key Cloner mission), Tyrone’s labs (after Here, Kitty Kitty) and Moses / Scooter Bros (register cheap cars as you go).
Rob Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2 for Let’s Go Bowling.
Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears — it is time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so save first.
Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs gives the Snap Gun (Sneakthief); Credit Check gives the Dye Pack Jammer (Dime on the Dollar).
Scan vehicles, animals and WAiNK spots as you travel — 200 vehicle scans, 100 animal studies and 100 WAiNK scans feed the 100% checklist.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Chapters 2–3

details: That’s Where The Money Is… opens bank vaults (Maximum Withdrawal, Hot Together, A Classic Blitz Play).
Finish the story for the chapter trophies and the final-mission Gold.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Chapters 4–5 and the finale
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

details: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist (A Long Road): all robberies including 8 vaults and 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, all Shooting Range golds, all drone races, Bret’s 15 Target Decks, 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans.
Finish the six side-story finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret), 8 Strangers & Freaks strands, the garages and Scooter Bros registrations.
Clean up the free-roam trophies: the VCIA jet, the tank, Combat Focus, and clearing the map fog.
stages.title: Stage 4 — After the credits (the long grind, ~100 h)

missables.note: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation may be required. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
Yago’s Chapter 3 race is time-sensitive (hourglass icon). Do it the moment it appears and save first.
Do not push towards the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent.
